notes.title: Patch 1: Claws and Customization
notes.notes: [p]Scissorpaw is here! Blood girl evolutions are here! The programmers trying to kill me are here! I have to run![/p][p]And you have to run the game to experience all the new changes, detailed list below![/p][p]Steam achievements coming soon™, Steam cards and emojis will be available as soon as steam approves them![/p][p][/p][p][b]Warning! This updates changes make the saved games from previous versions (0.5.16 and below) incompatible. If you want to finish your games, you need to do it before updating the game. You can acess previous release version through Steam Betas system.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Major gameplay changes:[/h3][p]- Updated game UI view. [/p][p]- Added option to manually enlist units to quests and kick them out. [/p][p]- Added button allowing to demolish player Structures. [/p][p]- Major overhaul of decoration system. [/p][p]- Major map generation changes - rivers, bridges and better cliffs.[/p][p]- Added new perks: "The Few, The Mighty", "Sun God's Covenant", "Larger Than Life," "Training Arcs," "Gambler's Covenant", "People's Champion" and "Humility". [/p][p]- Added new player's unit - Yandere! She may need your help somewhere in the wilds. [/p][p]- Added new player's unit - Scissor Paw! Keep her away from Mooladin, ok..?[/p][p]- Added new forms to Blood Girl - she starts as a small blob of blood and grows bigger as it feeds on it's host.[/p][p]- Added some slice of life events - concerts, arguments, duels and betting![/p][p]- Added Gambling Hall structure, where you and your adventurers can bet your hard earned gold for a chance at even greater riches![/p][p]- Added voice lines for more characters![/p][p][/p][h3]Smaller changes and bugfixes:[/h3][p]- Optimized tree rendering and made them look a little better.[/p][p]- Tweaked ambient occlusion settings for buildings.[/p][p]- Current behaviour of units on Creature UI will now refresh correctly.[/p][p]- Fixed issue where same Perk could be offered twice in the same selection.[/p][p]- Tweaked balance of units fear.[/p][p]- Added income rate difficulty setting.[/p][p]- Fixed mysterious cube spawning sometimes during bounty quests. You will be missed Cube-chan.[/p][p]- Added ability to reorder goal cards by drag and dropping them.[/p][p]- Tweaked visuals of Perk Cards.[/p][p]- Smoothed out Fog of War discovery visuals.[/p][p]- Changed visuals of how units fade into the distance.[/p][p]- Lowered chances of exploring units walking into a corner and staying there.[/p][p]- Improved visuals of lights - especially lanterns.[/p][p]- Fixed bugs where units could cheat death by not attacking with certain perks.[/p][p]- Fixed hostile spawner buildings not spawning enemies.[/p][p]- Fixed reroll perks functionality, so that it no longer locks player out of not chosen perks.[/p][p]- Fixed Gobbo Hideout being unclickable.[/p][p]- Increased level where Sunflower Knight learns his Sunflower Field special attack from 10 to 20.[/p][p]- Fixed units not being able to approach Prison Tower.[/p][p]- Made Lightbringers more likely to explore.[/p][p]- Added setting allowing players to further limit Blob size.[/p][p]- Fixed issues preventing player from loading the game. At least some of them - send us your broken saves please![/p][p]- Added warning for save version incompatible with application version. You can access previous game versions through Steam Betas system if you want to finish your previous run.[/p]

notes.title: Stragglers Patch 2/2
notes.notes: [p]After proper testing and first beta players' feedback we are proud to present to you second part of our stragglers patch![/p][p][/p][p]What can you expect to find here:[/p][p][/p][h3]New units![/h3][list][*][p]Bloodgirl - Sometimes, death is cute! For now, has chance to spawn if there are many graves in close proximity, and it then "imprints" on a first strong host it finds, changing faction to that of the host and following them around. Needs blood to survive. [/p][list][*][p]current bloodgirl only has "final" evolution, 2 smaller evolutions will come in the next weeks![/p][/*][*][p]more attacks also incoming[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Dryad - When a bee and a flower love each other very much, sometimes a dryad appears. She plants traps, that your units can walk into and get captured becoming fertiliser for her plant. If you defeat her before she finishes consuming them, they will pop out and survive![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Lightbringer evolution! She made a high-lvl debut, and painted her hair light-blond.[/p][list][*][p]special attacks incoming soon (tm)[/p][/*][*][p]better stats![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Slug boss! A new hot unit, a real party animal, with many cool friends! Second boss in survival mode.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]First wolf boss also got some fancy new skills and new look![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI![/h3][list][*][p]Windowed Structure UI - If you feel like managing your structures is interrupting your gameplay you can now enable "Windowed building UI" in "Other" tab in settings. Favorite feature of some of the devs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bugfixes![/h3][list][*][p]We fixed few bugs that could prevent save from loading. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Blobs were causing massive stuttering when player moved camera to them. They were just a little shy ok?[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Probably created more new bugs in exchange.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Stragglers Patch 1/2
notes.notes: [p]First part of our Stragglers changes. New units incoming in second half![/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New spell: Ritual of teleportation[/p][/*][*][p]Skins and hats for chosen units[/p][/*][*][p]Made actions and items of creatures visible in their UI[/p][/*][*][p]Added difficulty settings that can be chosen before starting a new run[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Balancing changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Day structure:[/p][list][*][p]Increased day length from 10 minutes to 15 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased night length from 8 to 6 in game hours and increased morning length from 4 to 6 hours.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Survival mode: [/p][list][*][p]Increased length of survival mode from 7 to 10 days.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased difficulty of survival mode waves.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced difficulty of specific days of survival mode for better experience.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p] Economy:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced farms and economy structures passive incomes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Recruitment:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced all recruitment caps to 1, except for Gobbo hideout which was reduced to 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Added set of upgrades to recruitment structures, which raise the recruitment cap.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed miscellaneous graphical issues - floating vines, clipping benches and meshes being cut off[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed godbeast behaviour feedbacks not being saved properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bird animations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where beast tamer was terrified of sheer thought of going to distant animal[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs where tamed rats either got so lazy that they were constantly staying in single place or kept stealing from the player[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs where renamed characters were deadnamed in the relationship tab[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where obelisks could not be attacked[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where saves with upgradeable structures could not be loaded[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Shooting Tower structure did not deal any damage to hit enemies[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 01!
notes.notes:

notes.title: 4 weeks until release!
notes.notes:
[h3]4 weeks until release![/h3][p]
Ready your calendars as the [b][u]July 31st[/u][/b] is the big-big-release day! Perfect thing to do during summer heat waves, as it's too hot to be outside! Skip work to play, your boss won't notice as they will be playing GG-AG as well! Mention it to your favourite streamer/youtuber, buy 10 copies and give them away on the street!
[/p][p]"Wait..." I hear some of you say, wasn't the game supposed to be out already? As some of you might have noticed already on the steam page, after the Summer Next Fest demo feedback, we realised the game needs a bit more time in the oven to address common complaints, and to add more stuff!

What stuff you ask? Well, if you were to join our community discord you could find a whole long post with planned updates, as well as our current progress! Or, if someone asks I will just paste it in the comments, who knows![/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/KY2Sm8S8wV"]Join the discord! do it![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4qwmdyZns3Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p]
